intro: This awareness course covered what a care plan is, what makes a good one, and how you follow, contribute to and review it.
points: This is awareness only — formal assessment and authoring the care plan sit with a trained assessor, not with you.
Follow the plan faithfully and never freelance; if it seems wrong or out of date, raise it rather than quietly changing it.
Assume capacity under the Mental Capacity Act, support decisions, and respect unwise but understood choices; consent can be withdrawn at any time.
Work in a person-centred way, planning around the individual's outcomes, wishes and strengths — treating them as the expert on their own life.
Notice and record changes factually and promptly, and escalate anything affecting safety that cannot wait for the next review.
Keep records accurate, timely and confidential in line with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
